name: Sabine Varnes
biography: Sabine Varnes is a Canadian stuntwoman and actress. She enrolled in gymnastics at the age of 6 and shortly thereafter began competing. She won numerous local, regional and provincial honors over her ten year span. She graduated from Richmond High School in 1992 and then moved to Hawaii to further her gymnastics training and coaching skills. Sabine returned to Vancouver half a year later and moved to Whistler/Blackcomb mountain, where she enjoyed snowboarding and made lifelong friends. Continuing with her travels, she moved to Toronto, Canada and then Los Angeles, California to pursue a career as a stunt woman.
